document.title: PROCEDIMIENTO SORTEOS ELECTRÓNICOS
document.emitting_area: SUBDIRECCIÓN GENERAL DE VENTAS Y OPERACIONES

verified_provisions.claim: Weighing is performed for each draw; Smartballs 4.25-5.25 g with max spread 0.30 g; Ping Pong 2.30-3.00 g with max spread 0.15 g; nonconforming case is replaced and reweighed.
Each sphere is weighed one by one in numerical order in presence of SEGOB inspector and LN representatives.
Weighing strip is signed, reviewed/rubricated by specified representatives, and attached to the corresponding draw act.
Draw act records place, date, time, roles/signatures of LN representatives and SEGOB inspector, results and incidents.
TIRA DE PESAJE is listed as a record for Chispazo.
CS-11 check includes date, draw number, case number, sphere-versus-number correspondence and participants.
Tira records each sphere weight and the responsible/representative/SEGOB signatures.
Electronic signature of the participation file is recorded on a storage device before the draw, delivered to the SEGOB inspector and deposited in a safe accessible only to the Internal Control Body.
Draw reports and electronic signature of winners relation are archived weekly on DVD and attached to the Acts.
Delayed Act signing up to five business days requires a log entry; CS-18 communicates risks.
Room attendance uses CS-12; cleaning/maintenance is recorded in controlled access logs.
